headline: Technology and International Small-Cap Leadership Persists Alongside Sector-Level Divergences
market_regime: Selective Rotation with Divergent Sector-Level Dynamics and Horizon Splits
executive_summary: Cross-sectional analysis reveals focused strength in Cloud Computing (SKYY score 98.54) and International Small Caps (SCZ score 86.67, reaching a 63-bar score high), alongside notable emerging signals in US Energy (XLE score 85.56). However, internal divergence is elevated across key sectors including Health Care (IHI improving by +35.21 score points while IHF falls -39.28 points over 20 bars) and Industrials (ITA up +36.55 score points while IYT falls -30.02 points). Defensive areas like Food & Beverage (PBJ score 19.38) and Utilities (XLU score 23.33) remain in confirmed rotation out conditions.

emerging_rotations.title: EAFE Small Cap Emerging Leadership
emerging_rotations.explanation: SCZ maintains a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 86.67, marking a 63-bar score high following a 20-bar score improvement of +37.38 and a 5-bar score change of +13.1. Its relative strength profile across horizons is split, recording a positive 20-bar relative strength of +0.42 percentage points alongside a negative 63-bar relative strength of -1.25 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: US Energy Sector Emerging Acceleration
emerging_rotations.explanation: XLE displays a confirmed EMERGING trend state with a rotation score of 85.56 and a 5-bar score change of +12.37. It carries an unconfirmed early warning raw state of ACCELERATING (1/3 observations), backed by positive relative strength across both horizons (+2.89 percentage points over 20 bars and +3.35 percentage points over 63 bars).

accelerating_rotations.explanation: EIRL holds a confirmed ACCELERATING state with a rotation score of 74.0 and a 5-bar score change of +1.07. Relative strength is confirmed positive on both horizons, registering +0.38 percentage points over 20 bars and +10.17 percentage points over 63 bars.

persistent_leaders.explanation: SKYY leads the dataset with a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state and a score of 98.54. reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: XBI exhibits a confirmed REACCELERATING state with a score of 69.38 and a 5-bar score change of +8.26. weakening_rotations.explanation: IHF records a confirmed WEAKENING trend state with a rotation score of 41.46 (a 63-bar score low) following a 20-bar score drop of -39.28 and a 5-bar score change of -24.1. Its relative strength signals are mixed across horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at -3.55 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains positive at +7.1 percentage points.

rotation_out.explanation: PBJ sits in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with a score of 19.38 and a 20-bar score deterioration of -22.66. Relative strength is negative across both horizons (-5.62 percentage points over 20 bars and -4.38 percentage points over 63 bars), with CMF20 at an extreme negative level of -0.714.

rotation_out.title: Brazil Relative Leadership Weakness
rotation_out.explanation: EWZ confirms a ROTATION_OUT state with a low rotation score of 22.5 and a 20-bar score change of -30.3. Relative strength is negative over both horizons, registering -8.91 percentage points over 20 bars and -12.17 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Nordic Relative Strength in Sweden
geographic_rotations.explanation: EWD displays a confirmed EMERGING state with a score of 75.53 and a 20-bar score gain of +27.6. Relative strength is positive across both 20-bar (+0.64 percentage points) and 63-bar (+1.98 percentage points) horizons, contrasting with weakening performance in European peers such as Switzerland (EWL score 34.0).

pair_relationships.title: US Large-Cap Value vs Growth Spread
pair_relationships.explanation: IWD maintains a confirmed ACCELERATING state (with an early warning raw WEAKENING state pending 2/3 observations) and a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal against paired ticker IWF (pending PAIR_MIXED for 1 observation). The direct pair spread shows horizon conflict, lagging IWF over 20 bars by -0.7 percentage points while leading over 63 bars by +10.69 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: S&P 500 Equal Weight vs Cap Weight Spread
pair_relationships.explanation: RSP holds a confirmed NEUTRAL state with a score of 59.85 and a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal versus paired ticker SPY (pending PAIR_MIXED for 2 observations). The performance spread versus SPY is split across horizons, trailing over 20 bars by -0.04 percentage points while leading over 63 bars by +5.77 percentage points.

cross_market_confirmations: International small-cap relative leadership is consistent across regional structures, with EAFE small cap (SCZ score 86.67, 63-bar score high) and broad international small cap (VSS score 75.0, 63-bar score high, 20-bar score change +46.43) demonstrating aligned relative momentum over large-cap EAFE (EFA score 53.33).

US Energy relative leadership is supported globally, as US Energy (XLE score 85.56, 20-bar score change +11.01) outpaces Global Energy (IXC score 60.0), generating a positive 20-bar pair spread of +1.43 percentage points in favor of XLE.
risks_or_conflicts: Health Care exhibits acute intra-sector divergence: Medical Devices (IHI) improved by +35.21 score points over 20 bars, whereas Health Care Providers (IHF) deteriorated by -39.28 score points over the same period.
Industrials displays internal sector conflict: Aerospace & Defense (ITA) gained +36.55 score points over 20 bars, while Transportation (IYT) declined by -30.02 score points.
Consumer Discretionary shows severe internal splitting: Global Consumer Discretionary (RXI) gained +36.0 score points over 20 bars, whereas US Retail (XRT) dropped -23.31 score points.
Information Technology demonstrates internal dynamic disagreement: Software (IGV) improved by +34.49 score points over 20 bars, while Semiconductors (SMH) fell -20.65 score points.

Global REITs (REET) presents a pair state tension: REET carries a confirmed WEAKENING trend state with a score of 49.11, yet maintains a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal over paired ticker XLRE due to a split spread profile (-0.66 percentage points over 20 bars versus +0.82 percentage points over 63 bars).
methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
